name: PubMed annual baseline (MEDLINE/PubMed XML)
application: Biomedical literature mining, LM pretraining, IR, MeSH indexing
sample_count: Not reported (baseline is 'a complete snapshot of PubMed data')
temporal_coverage: Annual snapshot released at end of each year; daily update files
collection_method: NLM-produced citation records; language: predominantly English (Assessment: not stated on page)
annotation: MeSH indexing in MEDLINE records (Assessment: not described on fetched page)
license: Terms and Conditions in README.txt bundled with baseline/update files; downloading indicates acceptance
access_prerequisites: None stated; acceptance of NLM Terms and Conditions (README.txt) by downloading
version: Annual baseline (year-specific; current file names not verified)
checksum_or_manifest: Not verified (FTP directory listing blocked by robots.txt)
limitations: Load baseline then daily updates in numerical order; revised/deleted citations must replace local copies
verification_method: WebFetch of pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/download (old nlm.nih.gov page says no longer maintained); FTP listing fetch blocked by robots.txt

name: PMC Open Access Subset
download_or_api_url: s3://pmc-oa-opendata (https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/, us-east-1); OAI-PMH, E-Utilities, BioC API
application: Full-text biomedical text mining, LM pretraining
file_formats: XML, plain text, PDF (per PMC AWS page); JSON metadata per article
collection_method: Journal articles and preprints under Creative Commons or similar licenses
license: Varies per article ('license terms vary'); license type recorded in per-article JSON metadata
access_prerequisites: No login; AWS CLI --no-sign-request. Bulk retrieval only via Cloud, OAI-PMH, E-Utilities or BioC API; other automated bulk retrieval prohibited; users responsible for copyright compliance
download_method: AWS S3 (AWS Open Data Sponsorship), OAI-PMH, E-Utilities, BioC API
version: Continuously updated; S3 Inventory generated daily
limitations: Legacy oa_comm/oa_noncomm split and baseline/incremental bulk packages discontinued as of August 2026 (per PMC AWS page); mixed licenses incl. non-commercial

name: MIMIC-IV-Note: Deidentified free-text clinical notes
application: Clinical NLP, summarization, information extraction, LLM evaluation
modality: Clinical free text (discharge summaries, radiology reports)
geographic_coverage: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, MA, USA
collection_method: EHR notes from BIDMC; English; de-identified per HIPAA Safe Harbor, PHI replaced with '___'
access_prerequisites: PhysioNet credentialed user; CITI Data or Specimens Only Research training; signed DUA
citation: Johnson A, Pollard T, Horng S, Celi LA, Mark R. MIMIC-IV-Note (2023). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/1n74-ne17

name: MedQA (USMLE)
application: Open-domain medical exam QA, LLM benchmarking
geographic_coverage: US (English), Mainland China (Simplified Chinese), Taiwan (Traditional Chinese) exams
collection_method: Questions from medical licensing exams; languages English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese; textbook corpus in English and Simplified Chinese
annotation: Exam answer keys; standard and 4_options versions (US, Mainland China)
citation: Jin D, et al. What Disease does this Patient Have? A Large-scale Open Domain Question Answering Dataset from Medical Exams. arXiv:2009.13081 (2020)

name: PubMedQA
collection_method: Questions derived from PubMed article titles/abstracts; English
annotation: PQA-L expert-labelled; PQA-A artificially generated; PQA-U unlabelled
download_method: GitHub data/ dir (PQA-L); Google Drive (PQA-U, PQA-A); HF datasets
citation: Jin Q, Dhingra B, Liu Z, Cohen W, Lu X. PubMedQA: A Dataset for Biomedical Research Question Answering. EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019, pp. 2567-2577
limitations: HF card marks curation, bias and limitations sections '[More Information Needed]'
verification_method: WebFetch of pubmedqa.github.io, GitHub README, HF API JSON + dataset card

name: MedMCQA
feature_count: Fields: question, opa-opd, cop, exp, subject_name, topic_name, choice_type
collection_method: Questions from AIIMS and NEET PG entrance exams; English; 21 subjects, 2.4k topics
citation: Pal A, Umapathi LK, Sankarasubbu M. MedMCQA. Proc. CHIL 2022, PMLR 174:248-260
limitations: Test ground truth not released publicly (GitHub); GitHub lists validation 6,150 / test 4,183 vs HF validation 4,183 / test 6,150; licence differs between HF and GitHub
verification_method: WebFetch of medmcqa.github.io, GitHub README, HF API JSON + card

name: BioASQ
application: Biomedical semantic indexing, QA, summarization, IE challenges
collection_method: Expert-written English biomedical questions (Task B); 2026 tasks incl. Synergy, MultiClinSum-2 (EN/ES/FR/PT), BioNNE-R (RU/EN), ElCardioCC (Greek), GutBrainIE
annotation: Relevant articles, snippets, exact and ideal answers by experts
version: All versions for all tasks available in Participants Area
citation: Not reported (site points to public documents incl. 2025 overview and BioASQ-QA corpus papers)

name: n2c2 (formerly i2b2) NLP Research Data Sets
application: Clinical NLP shared tasks: de-id, smoking, obesity, medication, relations, coreference, temporal, heart disease risk, ADE, STS, family history, normalization
collection_method: Fully deidentified clinical notes from partner institutions; English (Assessment: language not stated)
access_prerequisites: Individual registration on DBMI Data Portal and DUA; no sharing or public posting
citation: Per-dataset challenge papers listed on data-sets page
limitations: Each user must access independently; redistribution prohibited
verification_method: WebFetch of n2c2.dbmi.hms.harvard.edu/data-sets and DBMI portal project page

name: UMLS Metathesaurus
application: Concept normalization, entity linking, terminology mapping
collection_method: Integrates many vocabularies incl. CPT, ICD-10-CM, LOINC, MeSH, RxNorm, SNOMED CT
license: UMLS Metathesaurus License (individual, no charge); some sources need additional agreements
access_prerequisites: UTS account + individual UMLS license (not issued to groups/organizations)
limitations: Needs ~40 GB disk; MetamorphoSys 2-10 h; source-vocabulary restrictions apply
verification_method: WebFetch of UMLS home + Knowledge Sources download page

name: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH)
download_method: HTTPS bulk files; MeSH Browser; RDF API/SPARQL
verification_method: WebFetch of MeSH home + MeSH download page

name: NCBI Disease Corpus
sample_count: 793 PubMed abstracts; 6,892 disease mentions; 790 unique concepts
annotation: 14 annotators in pairs, three phases, corpus-wide consistency checks
download_method: Direct download (train/dev/test, mention-level and full sets)
citation: Dogan RI, Leaman R, Lu Z. NCBI disease corpus (J Biomed Inform 2014) (Assessment: journal not on fetched page)
mirrors: Hugging Face bigbio collection (Assessment: not verified this session)

name: BioCreative V CDR corpus (BC5CDR)
application: Chemical/disease NER, normalization, chemical-induced disease relation extraction
target: Chemical & disease mentions with concept IDs; CID relations
annotation: Human mention- and concept-level annotations plus CDR relations
license: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (HF bigbio card); not stated on BioCreative page
access_prerequisites: None stated ('freely available for the research community')
download_method: HF mirror zip; BioCreative resources page (403 on fetch)
citation: Li J, Sun Y, Johnson RJ, et al. BioCreative V CDR task corpus. Database 2016; doi:10.1093/database/baw068
verification_method: WebFetch of BioCreative track page + HF API/card; BioCreative corpus page 403; PMC paper blocked by captcha

name: MedNLI
collection_method: Past Medical History sections of MIMIC-III v1.4 notes (deceased patients); de-identified; English
annotation: Premise-hypothesis pairs with gold labels and parses
access_prerequisites: Credentialed PhysioNet user; CITI training; PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

name: SNOMED CT (US Edition / International)
access_prerequisites: US: UMLS license/UTS account; free in Member countries; non-Member territories license via MLDS with possible fees
version: US Edition 20260901; US bi-annual (Mar/Sep), International Edition monthly
limitations: Licensing fees may apply in non-Member territories
verification_method: WebFetch of NLM SNOMED CT pages + snomed.org/get-snomed

name: LOINC
version: 2.83 (2026-08-19); releases Feb and Aug, monthly planned from 2027

name: emrQA
sample_count: 1,957,835 QA pairs; 1,225,369 question-logical form pairs; 2,425 clinical notes
collection_method: Semi-automatic generation from i2b2 2006 smoking, 2008 obesity, 2009 medications, 2010 relations, 2014 heart disease annotations
annotation: Template-generated QA from existing i2b2 annotations
access_prerequisites: Sign n2c2 data use agreement via DBMI portal
citation: Pampari A, et al. emrQA: A Large Corpus for Question Answering on Electronic Medical Records. EMNLP 2018
limitations: Assessment: templated questions; depends on n2c2 access

name: MTSamples transcribed medical reports
collection_method: User-contributed sample reports; English; 'all names and dates have been changed (or removed)'
license: Not reported; may print, share or link for educational purposes with attribution to MTSamples.com
limitations: Not guaranteed complete or error free; accuracy not certified; not authentic patient records

name: CORD-19
download_or_api_url: Historical releases in AI2 S3 bucket (linked from repo)
sample_count: Over 1 million papers; nearly 370,000 with full text
license: Varies by paper (CC0, CC-BY, Gold OA, Green OA, others)
citation: Wang LL, et al. CORD-19: The COVID-19 Open Research Dataset. NLP-COVID workshop, ACL 2020
limitations: No longer updated; mixed per-paper licenses
